what: what the battery caught: a retrieval hot path, plus on-box resources under load

finding.symptom: steady keep-alive p50 2.44 s server-side on one worker; the other worker answered the same query in 0.4 ms
finding.trigger: a nova lite plan with 5 slots and a total budget of 135: tight price masks plus 'women's summer X' queries left the type gate short of matches, so _rank_distinct widened its window x4 per pass and _rank fully hydrated every window row through per-row pandas iloc
finding.profile: 19,783 _hydrate calls in one request, 6.5 s of 7.4 s inside pandas fast_xs; under 12-way load the same plan hit retrieve_ms 10404
finding.fix: scoring fields (title, rating, count, audience, group key) now come from one vectorized column gather per window; the full per-row hydration runs only for the rows a slot returns
finding.proof: replay of the captured plan on the box: 2831 ms before, 985 ms after in a cold process; live steady p50 fell from 2442 ms to 12.8 ms; regression test pins the behavior
finding.why_it_hid: us-east-1 ran nova micro, whose plans rarely carried budgets; the local eval uses sonnet plans; only live lite traffic walked this path

resources_during_battery.peak_during: unique-query ramp cells c24 and c32: the retrieval cpu ceiling, throughput flat at 10-13 req/s there
resources_during_battery.leak_check: host memory flat across 10,000+ requests including the 5 minute soak

restart_cost.note: single box: a deploy costs ~7 s of 5xx through cloudfront. a second origin behind failover, or socket activation, removes it. accepted for a demo, listed as the first production gap
